    Roop Vihar Resort (also known as Roop Vihar Resorts Private Limited) is a popular hotel, restaurant, and event venue located in Bhagalpur, Bihar. 
    Location & Contact
    • Address: R. H. Lane / Housing Board Chowk, Barari Road, Barari, Bhagalpur, Bihar 812003 
    • Distance: Around 4.5 to 6.3 km from Bhagalpur Junction Railway Station 
    • Contact Numbers: +91 7631005599, +91 9801897235, +91 9801897235, +91 7488515406 
    • Official Website: Roop Vihar Resorts 
    Key Amenities & Features
    • Accommodations:
      Offers Standard, Deluxe, Suite, Executive Suite, and Maharaja Royal Suite options with free Wi-Fi, air conditioning, and streaming services.
       
    • Facilities: Outdoor infinity swimming pool, Maharaja Restaurant, banquet hall, wedding/party lawn, and organic gardens. 
    • Dining: Serves North Indian and Chinese cuisines on-site, and is available for delivery via Swiggy and Zomato. 
    • Check-in / Check-out: Check-in starts at 12:00 PM and check-out is by 11:00 AM. 
    Are you looking to book a room, reserve the banquet/lawn for an event, or check the restaurant menu?
